error[ZBX-E0416]: the disk is full while writing the store
  cause  2 objects (16 bytes) were written before the disk filled; they are
         whole and kept
  fix    free space on the disk that holds the store, then run the same command again:   df -h '/home/alice/.local/share/zbx/store'
  more   zbx explain E0416 · rerun with --verbose for the full cause chain
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0416.html
